title: dabanus pinnatus
intro: Dabanus pinnatus, commonly known as Dabai or the 'king of fruits', is a tropical plant that belongs to the family Annonaceae. The health benefits of Dabanus pinnatus include its potential to help lower cholesterol levels, manage diabetes, and provide antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dabanus pinnatus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of Dabanus pinnatus include annonacin, corossolol, and other annonaceous acetogenins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
